description.zh:
是否开启GRPC，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Controls whether gRPC is enabled. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

- on: gRPC is enabled.

- off: gRPC is disabled.

description.zh:
是否开启HTTP2回源，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Controls whether HTTP/2 to origin is enabled. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

- on: HTTP/2 to origin is enabled.

- off: HTTP/2 to origin is disabled.

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true。
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")。
description.en:
The conditional expression used to match requests. This parameter is optional for global configurations.

- To match all incoming requests, set the value to true.

- To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq "video.example.com").

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Controls whether the rule is enabled. This parameter is optional for global configurations. Valid values:

- on: The rule is enabled.

- off: The rule is disabled.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. This parameter is optional for global configurations.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行。
description.en: The rule execution order. Smaller values have higher priority.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. Call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain this ID.

description.zh:
是否开启智能路由服务，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Controls whether smart routing is enabled. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

- on: Smart routing is enabled.

- off: Smart routing is disabled.

description.zh: 最大上传文件大小，单位是MB，取值范围：100～500。
description.en: The maximum upload file size, in MB. The value must be an integer from 100 to 500.

description.zh:
是否开启Websocket，默认开启。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Controls whether WebSocket is enabled. This feature is enabled by default. Valid values:

- on: WebSocket is enabled.

- off: WebSocket is disabled.

title.zh: 修改站点网络优化配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-network-optimization --site-id 1234560000 --config-id 352816096987136 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --smart-routing on --http2-origin on --websocket on --grpc on --upload-max-filesize 100 --sequence 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateNetworkOptimization --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --SmartRouting on --RuleEnable on --Websocket on --ConfigId 352816096987136 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --Sequence 1 --Grpc on --Http2Origin on --RuleName rule_example --UploadMaxFilesize 100
